top_story: Israeli military pressure intensified across the Palestinian territories on 1 November, as Gaza absorbed lethal drone and air strikes that killed at least eight people, including police personnel and a young child, while Hebron entered its tenth day under siege with home demolitions and mass business closures. In Yemen, the late-October indication that the UAE is covertly aiding Ansarallah against Saudi-backed forces points to a sharper fragmentation inside the anti-Houthi camp, complicating any coherent regional security alignment. The wider picture is of conflicts increasingly shaped by coercive pressure on civilian space and by shifting partnerships that erode already fragile political order.
